info.name: Just Eat API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the just-eat.ch clone — a production-grade food delivery platform API built with Node.js, Express, TypeScript, MongoDB, and Redis.

Base URL: http://localhost:4005/api/v1

Supported languages: EN, FR, DE, IT (default: DE)

item.name: 💳 Payments

request.description: Stripe webhooks require valid signature. This is a template.

item.description: Payment processing — multi-provider payment system with Stripe (cards), TWINT (Swiss mobile), PostFinance (Swiss bank), and Cash on Delivery. Includes sandbox simulation endpoints for TWINT/PostFinance, webhook integrations, admin refunds, and payment status tracking.

item.name: 🚚 Deliveries
item.description: Delivery management — courier pool, delivery acceptance, status tracking (PENDING → ASSIGNED → PICKED_UP → IN_TRANSIT → DELIVERED), real-time courier location updates, customer delivery tracking, and admin delivery management.

item.name: ⭐ Reviews
item.description: Review system — customer reviews with ratings, restaurant owner replies, admin moderation (approve/reject/flag), rating summaries with star distribution. One review per order, verified purchases only.

item.name: ❤️ Favorites
item.description: Favorites — toggle, list, check, and remove favorite restaurants. Customer-only feature with populated restaurant details.

item.description: Promotions — coupons (platform + restaurant-scoped) and stamp loyalty cards. Supports percentage/flat discounts, usage limits, minimum orders, and stamp-based rewards.

item.name: 🔔 Notifications
item.description: Notifications — in-app notifications with email delivery. Supports admin broadcasting, notification management (list, mark read, delete), unread count badge, and cross-module integration for order/delivery/review events.

item.name: 📊 Analytics
item.description: Analytics — read-only dashboards for platform admins and restaurant owners. Includes order/revenue overview, status breakdowns, time series, top items, and top restaurants. Supports 8 date presets and daily/weekly/monthly grouping.
